name: GHOSTED: A Dating Sim
source:
Finding love in the afterlife isn't hard here in the Old Manor — not when these ghosts have been wandering such lonely halls for so long! Spend five ghoul-filled nights getting to know the members of this ghostly house by exploring hidden corners in the manor, playing spooky minigames, and maybe — just maybe — finding romance beyond the grave!

[From [url=https://teadop.itch.io/ghosted-datingsim]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在老庄园里，在来世寻找真爱并不难——当这些鬼魂在如此孤独的大厅里徘徊了这么久的时候，这并不难！度过五个充满食尸鬼的夜晚，通过探索庄园中的隐蔽角落、玩怪异的小游戏来了解这座幽灵之家的成员，也许——只是也许——在坟墓之外找到浪漫！

[来自[url=https://teadop.itch.io/ghosted-datingsim]itch.io[/url]]
